svg.aria-label: While you play: Claude Code calls the Doom MCP server tools look, go_to and attack over MCP. The server trades a command file and state.json with Doom, and Doom trades only local files with the bridge, an MCP client. Every 15 seconds the bridge asks the Connect AI MCP server again: it re-runs each room’s query, re-reads kills and re-asks at the red door.
